moa: Plasma-derived C1 esterase inhibitor replacement (treatment of acute HAE attacks)

approval_evidence.quote: BERINERT ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2009 ... indicated for the treatment of acute abdominal, facial, or laryngeal hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks in adult and pediatric patients (FDA-hosted package insert)

series_start_reason: CSL prints product-level dollar sales for this brand only from the full-year FY2024 results presentation (year ended 30 June 2024) onward, in the Appendix 'CSL Behring Key Products' table; earlier presentations and annual reports print only percentage growth. Years are CSL fiscal years ending 30 June (period 2024 = July 2023 to June 2024), not calendar years.
annual_basis: CSL fiscal years FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026 (each ending 30 June), each read from that year's own full-year results presentation; the period label is the fiscal-year-end year.
notes: Worldwide Berinert sales as one line of CSL's table; the table gives no geographic split. No launch quarter is cited. FY2024 is labelled therapy group 'Specialty' and FY2025-26 'HAE' in the same table.
search_log: CSL files with the ASX, not the SEC, so no 10-K/10-Q exists; documents are CSL investor-relations PDFs (investors.csl.com). Downloaded FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026 full-year results presentations and the 1H26 half-year presentation and read them with pdftotext/pdfplumber.

Appendix A 'CSL Behring Key Products' prints the brand in US$ millions with change % at constant currency: FY24 Haegarda 491 / Berinert 242 (therapy group 'Specialty'); FY25 490 / 248; FY26 431 / 213 (therapy group 'HAE'). 1H24 presentation prints 245 / 120 and the 1H26 presentation 239 / 109 for the half-year (not used).

Earlier years not usable: FY2020, FY2021 and FY2022 results presentations print only growth percentages for HAEGARDA and BERINERT (for example HAEGARDA +14% and BERINERT -5% in FY2021, HAEGARDA +5% and BERINERT -6% in FY2022) and a chart of 'HAE' within 'Specialty Products' of $1.8B; FY2022 was seen only through search-result excerpts of the presentation. The FY2023 results presentation PDF could not be located, and the annual-report pages surfaced by search (2021, 2022, 2023) mention the brands with growth percentages only; the full annual reports were not read end to end, so a dollar line for FY2023 or earlier may exist. No figure was estimated from percentages.
Bigdata.com smart search returned no documents; sourcing used web search results pointing to investors.csl.com and direct PDF downloads.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: CSL results presentation for the half-year ended 31 December 2025, Appendix A CSL Behring Key Products, 1H26 Revenue By Therapy Group $m | Berinert HAE 109 (16%)
no_quarterly_series.details: CSL reports on a half-yearly and full-year basis (ASX Appendix 4D/4E); the investor presentations carry product sales for the half and the full year only. No quarterly product table was found. Quarters are not interpolated.
